intro.title: Zustand for Global State
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple counter app to learn how to manage global state across components using Zustand, a lightweight state management library for React. You'll understand the core concept of a global store—a single source of truth for state that can be accessed and updated from anywhere in your app without prop drilling. The main technologies involved are React functional components, Zustand's `create` function, and hooks like `useStore` to read and modify state. By the end, you'll be able to create a store, define state and actions, and connect multiple components to share and synchronize data seamlessly.
intro.usecase: Zustand is commonly used in modern React applications where multiple components need access to the same data without prop drilling. You'll see this in e-commerce sites where shopping cart state must be shared between product listings, cart previews, and checkout pages. Dashboard applications use Zustand to manage user preferences, theme settings, and filter states across various panels and widgets. It's also ideal for collaborative tools where real-time data like document editing status or user presence needs to be synchronized across different UI sections.
